what: The b-roll library: house-made footage filmed frame by frame from this build's own 3D campus and globe map. No third-party stock; every clip is first-party.
how: media/record.mjs (virtual clock, camera driven through the page hook, one screenshot per frame) -> media/encode.py (grade, VP9 + H.264, poster, 480 px preview) -> media/build.py

clips.grade: soft S-curve, saturation 1.07, contrast 1.03, vignette PI/6 (media/encode.py GRADE)

explainer.title: SmartCiti.X Holodeck, a two-minute tour
explainer.provenance: DERIVED: composed from recorded page footage and stills at 83db20b, captioned, silent
explainer.composition: Three recorded b-roll clips from this library (globe flyover, hall interior dolly, wilds mountain flyover), a recorded capture of the model arena, page stills, a title card, two text cards (the arena's measured success table and a how-it-is-built card) and an end card with the project contact; every caption is the registered captions text.
explainer.format_note: mp4 only (H.264), to keep the repository lean; no webm.
explainer.figures_note: The numbers spoken in the captions are those of the pages at commit 83db20b and are not refreshed here.
